sidebar.syncing.notes: Glossary: Update / Check for new mail.

sidebar.syncAllAccounts.proposed: Check all accounts for new mail

sidebar.syncError.accurate: no: the button opens the sync status dialog; it does not retry (Sidebar.svelte:423)
sidebar.syncError.proposed: Couldn't update this account. Show details

sidebar.syncErrorOAuthNotConfigured.accurate: unverified: matches the 'missing client ID' error text only
sidebar.syncErrorOAuthNotConfigured.proposed: This version of Mailven has no sign-in credentials for {provider}. Add your own in Settings, or install a version that includes them.
sidebar.syncErrorOAuthNotConfigured.notes: COPY-4, CTRL-5: client setup is expert-only. Fallback 'this provider' is hardcoded English (SyncStatusDialog.svelte:51).

sidebar.syncErrorReauthorize.accurate: no: shown for any provider and any token refresh failure, not only Google or Microsoft (SyncStatusDialog.svelte:52)
sidebar.syncErrorReauthorize.proposed: Your saved sign-in for this account stopped working. Sign in again.

sidebar.syncErrorFixAccount.notes: COPY-2: says where the button goes.

sidebar.syncingContent.accurate: unverified: assumes the content phase downloads message bodies

sidebar.noFoldersSynced.notes: Glossary; shown whenever the folder list is empty.

sidebar.syncErrorGeneric.notes: Added by UX-3: the plain main line for an update error with no known cause.

sidebar.syncErrorDetails.notes: Added by UX-3: the disclosure that holds the raw error.

sidebar.syncProviderFallback.notes: Added by UX-3: replaces a hard-coded English fallback.
